# A practice eval of the refund intent where the clerk is wrong. The people sent case g1 to a person, and the clerk proposes a refund of 80. That outcome costs 5,
# so the mean cost is above the demotion limit of 2 and the policy asks for a drop from contain to assist. A drop waits for no one: the run opens an item for a
# reviewed edit of policy.star and finishes. The desk does not change the policy.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:sha256sum] [!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

deskinit
deskfakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env DESK_DIR=$WORK/desk

exec beehavereal item add desk eval-refund --title 'Eval of refund' --body-file body.txt
exec beehavereal run eval-refund desk --workflow desk/eval.star
stdout 'item eval-refund finished'

exec sh desk/evals/score.sh refund eval-refund
stdout '"mean_cost": 5.000'

# One item asks for the drop to assist, and nothing asks for a promotion.
exec beehavereal item list desk
stdout -count=1 'Demote refund to assist in policy.star'
! stdout 'Promote'

-- body.txt --
refund
-- home/.desk/config --
DESK_API=http://desk.test
MAILDIR=/nonexistent/mail
CHAT_SPOOL=/nonexistent/chat
CHAT_API=http://chat.test
MASK_SALT=testsalt
-- home/.desk/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
-- home/.desk/gold/refund.tsv --
id	held	ka	aa	kb	ab	file
g1	no	person	0	person	0	g1.txt
-- home/.desk/gold/g1.txt --
Please refund 80 for BK-123456.
-- home/.desk/gold/costs.tsv --
person	refund	5
-- home/.desk/gold/refund-replies.tsv --
id	case	reply	ga	gb
r1	g1.txt	r1.txt	good	good
-- home/.desk/gold/r1.txt --
reply one
